Requirements You are wielding a weapon with the combination, modular, or two-hand trait.

In a flurry of movement, you Strike with the required weapon, Interact to change its configuration or change your grip on it, then Strike the same target again. If neither Strike is made in a configuration with the agile trait, the second Strike takes a –2 penalty. Both Strikes use your current multiple attack penalty, and if both hit, combine their damage and apply resistances and weaknesses only once.

prerequisites.value: 变幻狩猎 Shifting Hunt

Catalyzing Flask.name: 催化烧瓶 Catalyzing Flask
Catalyzing Flask.description:
你获得一个催化烧瓶作为次要工具，这是一个特殊的炼金小瓶，包含你选择的 1 级普通炼金灵药。你可以每天启动一次灵药而不消耗它，因为其中的怪物部件与剩余的液体反应产生更多并强化灵药。如果你在同一天第二次启动灵药，它将被完全消耗。当你 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-actions.Item.Wagb9XE34NpQQ8yy]{Reinforce your Arsenal} 时，你可以指定一个你等级或更低的不同的炼金灵药作为你催化烧瓶的内容物，替换之前的灵药，如果它被完全消耗，则重新装满烧瓶。

强化 当你启动催化烧瓶中的灵药时，你还会在强韧、反射或意志豁免上获得 +1 状态加值，取决于战利品来源生物哪项调整值最高。此加值持续 1 分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-effects.Item.usg85pETUqE6EwP5]{Effect: Catalyzing Flask (Reinforced)}

You gain a catalyzing flask as a secondary tool, a special alchemical vial which contains a level 0 common alchemical elixir of your choice. You can Activate the elixir within without consuming it once per day, as the monster parts within react with the remaining fluid to produce more and fortify the elixir. If you Activate the elixir a second time on the same day, it is fully consumed. You can designate a different alchemical elixir of your level or lower as the contents of your catalyzing flask when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-actions.Item.Wagb9XE34NpQQ8yy]{Reinforce your Arsenal}, replacing the previous elixir and refilling the flask if it was fully consumed.

Reinforced When you Activate the elixir within your catalyzing flask, you also gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, or Will saves, whichever the creature the trophy was claimed from had the highest modifier in. This bonus lasts for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-effects.Item.usg85pETUqE6EwP5]{Effect: Catalyzing Flask (Reinforced)}

prerequisites.value: 炼金师药瓶标志性工具 chymist's vials signature tool

Spiked Surcoat.name: 钉刺战袍 Spiked Surcoat
Spiked Surcoat.description:
你在护甲外穿着一件布满凶残尖刺的战袍，你将其作为一种次要工具获得。当穿着钉刺战袍时，每当你被无武装打击、非长触及近战武器打击命中，或被 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 时，攻击者受到等于1+你护甲潜能符文值的 @Damage[1[piercing]|options:spiked-surcoat]{piercing damage}。

强化 尖刺造成额外1点战利品的一种伤害类型的伤害。

You wear a set of vicious spikes over your armor, which you gain as a secondary tool. While wearing your spiked surcoat, whenever you are hit by an unarmed Strike, a Strike with a non-reach melee weapon, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, the attacker takes @Damage[1[piercing]|options:spiked-surcoat]{piercing damage} equal to 1 + the value of your armor's potency rune.

Reinforced The spikes deal an additional 1 damage of one of the trophy's damage types.

prerequisites.value: 符护链甲标志性工具 warded mail signature tool

Spell Slates.name: 法术石板 Spell Slates
Spell Slates.description:
你学会了如何用一套特别准备的护身符或符文来扩展你的魔法戏法，你将其作为次要工具获得。你获得一个 1 环常见异能法术和一个 2 环常见异能法术作为内在法术，每个法术每天可以施放一次。在 8 级时，你还获得一个 3 环常见异能法术作为内在法术，每天可以施放一次。

强化 你获得一个额外的常见内在法术，其环级等于或低于你从猎杀者专长获得的最高环级内在法术，每天可以施放一次。这个额外的法术必须属于战利品的根源，当你 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-actions.Item.Wagb9XE34NpQQ8yy]{Reinforce your Arsenal} 时，你可以将其换成具有相同限制的不同法术。

You've learned how to expand your magical tricks with a set of specially prepared charms or runes, which you gain as a secondary tool. You gain a 1st-rank common occult spell and a 2nd-rank common occult spell as innate spells, each of which you can cast once per day. At 8th level, you also gain a 3rd-rank common occult spell as an innate spell which you can cast once per day.

Reinforced You gain an additional common innate spell of a rank equal to or less than the highest-rank innate spell you have from slayer feats, which you can cast once per day. This additional spell must be of the trophy's tradition, and you can swap it for a different spell with the same restrictions when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.rr-playtest-actions.Item.Wagb9XE34NpQQ8yy]{Reinforce your Arsenal}.

prerequisites.value: 猎杀者戏法 Slayer's Tricks
